usage: Used as a casual noun for playing video games or gaming in general; very common in spoken Hong Kong Cantonese.
Often appears with verbs like 去, 返, or 鍾意 to talk about going to game, being into gaming, or making gaming plans.
Feels informal and everyday, so it fits conversation much better than formal writing.
Can refer to both the activity and the hobby itself; context usually makes the meaning clear.
